title: Correct r44 native failures and revalidate shared character interactions and corpse damage
acceptance_criteria: All required full native tests pass, including every r44 failure; player-backed fixtures reach authenticated gameplay assertions without lifecycle denial or closed-channel cascades.

Supported-host portrait coverage remains dynamic and complete, including explicit shared appearance support for the intentionally host-bound posture audio sheep fixture. Pressure cap coverage uses distinct due cadence slots and proves full-hit, cap-stop and healing-reopen behavior.

Pickup and pull retain shared nominated reach/LOS admission, action-specific policy and transactional custody; actual throw-to-pull, alive/critical/dead mouse pickup/pulling and reentrant pickup regressions pass without broadening automatic selection.

Retained corpse native hits, actual landing, typed transaction cancellation and pressure/blast damage pass through canonical damage events while preserving identity and Dead state; unsupported corpses and biological shutdown remain unchanged.
Full JVM, full native, affected readiness, controlled isolated client startup and JAR packaging pass; owner physical-input and GPU checks remain unverified.
manual_steps: Throw a mouse horizontally, then immediately Ctrl-left-click to pull it. Compare pickup and repeat with critical/dead mice; walls and out-of-reach targets must still deny.
Compare analyzer damage before and after a dead body's fall; repeat on Mouse and Human/Pig. Check existing fire/blast exposure. The original body must remain Dead.
Check Mouse/Human/Pig analyzer state, species and portrait; confirm held-camera smoothness, escape across hand transfers, real-drop interruption and cursor cleanup.
